markdown_content: # Flattening Improvements in Clo 2025.0 This document covers the latest updates and enhancements to the flattening tool in Clo 2025.0, focusing on its application with Clo avatars and imported OBJ files. It explains the improved layout, sewing features, and workflow for flattening patterns efficiently in the 3D environment. --- ## Overview of Flattening Tool Updates This section describes the key improvements made to the flattening tool in Clo 2025.0, including better pattern layout and sewing accuracy for both Clo avatars and imported OBJ models. Clo has enhanced the flattening tool to provide a more intuitive and accurate layout of patterns when flattening on Clo avatars and imported OBJ files. The new updates ensure that the flattened patterns are properly arranged to reflect the front, back, and sides of the avatar or object, reducing manual adjustment. These improvements also apply seamlessly to imported OBJ models, enabling users to flatten patterns on external 3D objects with the same ease and precision as on Clo's native avatars. This unified approach streamlines workflows and ensures consistency across different model types. --- ## Using the Flattening Tool with OBJ Models This section explains the step-by-step process of flattening patterns on OBJ models using the updated flattening tool, including selection, layout, and sewing behavior. 1. **Selecting Patterns for Flattening:** In the 3D window, access the flattening tool from the 3D toolbar. Hold down **Shift** to select multiple patterns on the OBJ model that you want to flatten. Exclude any patterns that should remain unflattened. 2. **Executing the Flattening Command:** After selecting the desired patterns, press **Enter** to flatten them. The tool automatically arranges the flattened pieces in a logical layout that corresponds to the front, back, and sides of the model. 3. **Verifying Layout and Sewing:** The flattened patterns appear neatly laid out, making it easy to identify parts such as the front, back, sleeves, and sides. Patterns that were flattened together are sewn, meaning their edges are connected appropriately to maintain garment integrity. 4. **Editing Patterns and Adding Missing Pieces:** If any pattern pieces are missed during selection (e.g., a sleeve), you can use the 3D Pen tool with **Control** held down to create curve points and add the missing pattern. Then, reselect and flatten the new piece to integrate it properly with the rest. 5. **Flattening All Pieces Together:** Flattening all patterns simultaneously ensures they are sewn together, producing a unified flattened layout. Alternatively, flattening pieces separately results in unsewn patterns. 6. **Adjusting Placement and Rotation:** The flattened layout can be rotated and adjusted within the 2D window to achieve the desired arrangement, facilitating easier pattern editing and visualization. --- ## Advantages of the Updated Flattening Tool This section highlights the benefits of the flattening tool improvements for pattern layout, sewing accuracy, and workflow efficiency. - **Accurate Front-Back-Side Layout:** The flattened patterns reflect the true orientation of the avatar or OBJ model, reducing confusion and manual corrections. - **Automatic Sewing of Flattened Pieces:** Flattened patterns that are selected together are automatically sewn, preserving garment construction and improving pattern continuity. - **Supports Both Clo Avatars and Imported OBJs:** The tool’s consistent behavior across native avatars and external OBJ files enhances flexibility for users working with various 3D models. - **Efficient Workflow:** The ability to select multiple patterns, flatten them simultaneously, and have them properly laid out and sewn saves time and effort in pattern preparation. - **Editing Flexibility:** Users can easily add or modify pattern pieces using the 3D Pen tool and update the flattening layout without complex steps. --- ## Summary The flattening tool in Clo 2025.0 introduces significant improvements in pattern layout accuracy, sewing functionality, and support for imported OBJ models. By providing a logical, sewn, and easily adjustable flattened pattern arrangement, these updates enhance the garment design workflow and reduce manual intervention. Users benefit from the streamlined process of selecting, flattening, and editing patterns both on Clo avatars and external 3D objects.
